Weighing skill against the crowd narrative, I lean T1, maybe around 57%, since their head-to-head record shows they can erase big deficits late. I want to be careful not to just follow the likely crowd favorite, but T1's comeback pattern and star power in Keria, Peyz, and Faker feel like the stronger pick here.
